session_asr_uncertainty.success_policy: original released automatic labels; CSRF never credited

agent_identification.features: released ten-family selection_rate_pct; absent families and empty sessions are zero

temporal.order: request_index within session; all classified non-others families
temporal.success_policy: released per-request automatic trace flags, including CSRF; not the CSRF-excluded session-ASR policy
temporal.aggregation: session macro over defined observations separately for each metric
temporal.ratio: quotient of macro-average switch-after-failure and switch-after-success

momentum.estimator: Spearman over 50 cells after within-agent z-standardization (ddof=0)
momentum.observation: pooled family counts reconstructed from released selection_rate_pct and asr
momentum.compliance: mean of nine injection sessions per agent-family cell
momentum.p_values: two-sided, unadjusted; paper interprets significance with Bonferroni correction
